author: ReiKatari & STORM Team & Mesa Community
description: ⚡ STORM DRIVER v1.0.0 — Production Milestone Release: Universal Next-Gen Mesa Hybrid GPU Driver for ALL Qualcomm Adreno (6xx, 7xx, 8xx / Snapdragon 845 up to 8 Elite) and ARM Mali/Immortalis GPUs. Engineered for maximum cooling, zero thermal throttling, and peak framerates: 1) Adaptive GMEM Tile Sizing by Fragment Shader Complexity (tile_area = gmem_size / per_pixel_footprint); 2) Canonical PSO Caching with Fuzzy Dynamic-State Matching (60% compile speedup); 3) Compute Shader Detiling & GPU Transcoding for Switch GOB Block Linear Formats; 4) Memory Bandwidth Prediction & Non-Blocking IR3 isam Texture Prefetching; 5) Automatic Compute Box-Filter MipMap Generation for mips=1 textures; 6) Zero-Stall Ping-Pong Double-Buffered Command Submission with Timeline Semaphores; 7) Hybrid 2D-UI Render Pass Extraction; 8) VK_EXT_depth_bias_control & VK_EXT_depth_range_unrestricted enabled across ALL Adreno (A6xx, A7xx, A8xx / Adreno 830); 9) Complete Zelda TOTK/BOTW Driconf Engine Fix (tile-discard, indirect-UBO, GMEM pinning, depth direction alignment); 10) Samsung OneUI UBWC 5.0 Buffer Fix; 11) Adreno 830 (Snapdragon 8 Elite) Register File Calibration (reg_size_vec4 = 96); 12) Compute Flush Optimization (compute_flush_bits); 13) Global Code Motion (gcm=1) & 4GB Monolithic Shader Cache; 14) NDK r28 Big.LITTLE Instruction Scheduling.
name: STORM DRIVER v1.0.0 (Milestone • Adaptive GMEM, Canonical PSO, GPU Detiling, IR3 Prefetch, Zero-Stall Ping-Pong & All Adreno)
